The Reality Code Engine

Write a program once as one complete state-machine blueprint, check it in 49 millijoules, and emit matching code across languages.

[2,221 Checks, 0 Failures · 49 mJ per Check]

1/3 You write a program once in one clear blueprint, and the computer generates matching code in many languages.

2/3 Every possible input must have a declared outcome up front, leaving nowhere for silent crashes to hide.

3/3 Once a repair passes every check, the engine saves and reuses it so nobody pays twice for one bug.
